graph: cycling (DIRECTED, respects oneway; oneway:bicycle contraflow NOT applied -- known limitation)
method: networkx cutoff-Dijkstra (exact), ONE 15-min run per origin, 5/10-min derived by sub-filtering the same reachable set -- not 3 separate Dijkstra runs, not Euclidean buffers.
unreachable_representation: NaN for nearest_time_min when no category destination is reachable within the 15-minute search horizon -- never a large finite placeholder value.
